name: saved-views-simple
description: IXT-SUITES: saved camera views (simple-tier). Save the current view, move the camera, apply the saved view (bumps applyViewNonce + sets pendingViewPose, forces orbit), then delete it. Store-driven (the UI lives in the View menu).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: assert-simple-present
steps.failMessage: savedViews (simple-tier) should be present in Simple mode

steps.name: assert-saved
steps.failMessage: saveCurrentView did not store the view

steps.name: assert-applied
steps.failMessage: applyView did not set the pending pose / bump the nonce

steps.name: assert-deleted
steps.failMessage: deleteView did not remove the saved view
